description: Intermarket compass — a first-pass read of the market environment through price-ratio lenses: asset-class rotation (bonds vs stocks, commodities), risk appetite (high-yield vs investment-grade credit, small vs large caps, cyclicals vs defensives), defensive flows (gold, utilities, yield-curve proxy) and the dollar. Each lens reports rising/falling vs its 50-day average plus the 20-day change; overall posture is risk_on, risk_off or mixed. Optional focus= ('gold'|'bonds'|'tech'|'commodities'|'equity'|'crypto') adds lenses specific to that asset class.

focus.description: Asset class being analysed — adds its specific lenses
